requirements.text: The HATS-GUI shall provide a graphical user interface for managing applications, parsing transformation language programs and target files, executing transformation language programs, and examining SDT and pretty-printed output.
The HATS-GUI shall allow users to create, delete, and modify files within an application, and manage file associations.
The HATS-GUI shall orchestrate the parsing of transformation language programs and target files by invoking HATS-SML services.
The HATS-GUI shall capture and display standard error and standard output streams generated by HATS-SML processes.
The HATS-GUI shall provide a visual representation of Syntax Derivation Trees (SDTs) with capabilities for navigation, expanding/collapsing nodes, and searching for sub-trees.
The HATS-GUI shall provide a text display window for pretty-printed output with capabilities for text selection and string searching.
The HATS-GUI shall allow users to configure application settings, including editor associations, node display colors and shapes, and default expansion levels.
The HATS-GUI shall be designed to minimize the number of windows opened by the application, avoiding a new window for every output file generated.
The HATS-GUI shall be platform-independent and function on Sun Solaris, Windows 2000, and Linux.
The HATS-GUI shall be developed using the Java programming language.
The HATS-GUI shall prompt the user for confirmation before overwriting existing files or deleting applications/files.
The HATS-GUI shall provide a menu-driven interface for all primary system functions.
The HATS-GUI shall notify the user if it fails to start a HATS-SML process, providing relevant error details from the Host OS.
